releaseLabel: Build 018 — Availability State Sync & Employee Workflow Specification

branding.primarySlogan: One World. One System. One Intelligent Network.

changes: Fixed availability selector behavior so the status chip label and color update immediately when an employee changes availability.

Added a build-specific implementation and verification checklist for employee work management, follow-ups, professional documents, LinkedIn, progression, intelligent ticket offers, HelpBuddy approvals/signatures, knowledge bases, manager controls, and backend security.

Added a unified Global Search Center above the workspace and Quick Picks, with live filtering of available preview records across users, tickets, devices when present, applications/products, documents, tasks, workflows, meetings/events, and conversations.
Added the Project Control Register, release ledger, QA/release checklist, and architecture/production-readiness baseline for Build 018.
